items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Died over there, Ben Webster, Don Byas, Oscar Pettiford.

ctx.x: Japan, they’re jazz fans over there. Oh, they love…and there are great jazz fans in Europe. That’s the reason why a lot of black musicians went over there and stayed. Died over there, Ben Webster, Don Byas, Oscar Pettiford.
